ten_core_treatments.title: Cancer & Oncology Care

ten_core_treatments.title: Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
ten_core_treatments.description: Robotic Total Knee & Hip Replacement, Spine fusion, Arthroscopic ligament reconstruction with rapid rehabilitation.

ten_core_treatments.description: High-success living donor liver and kidney transplants in dedicated ICU transplant units complying with NOTTO legal standards.

ten_core_treatments.title: Neurosurgery & Spine Care
ten_core_treatments.description: Brain tumor excision, deep brain stimulation, endoscopic spine surgery, and aneurysm clipping with intraoperative MRI.

ten_core_treatments.title: Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT)

ten_core_treatments.title: Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery
ten_core_treatments.description: Rhinoplasty, Liposuction, Breast augmentation/reduction, Hair transplantation, and Mummy makeovers by board-certified plastic surgeons.

ten_core_treatments.title: Urology & Nephrology
ten_core_treatments.description: Robotic prostatectomy, Laser kidney stone removal (RIRS/PCNL), dialysis support, and reconstructive urology.

ten_core_treatments.title: IVF & Fertility Treatments
ten_core_treatments.description: ICSI, IMSI, Pre-implantation genetic screening (PGS), Donor programs, and advanced embryology labs with high take-home baby rates.

ten_core_treatments.title: General & Laparoscopic Surgery
ten_core_treatments.description: Gallbladder removal, Hernia repair, Bariatric (weight loss) sleeve surgery, and gastrointestinal reconstructive operations.

six_facilitation_services.description: Affordable and hygienic guest houses, serviced apartments, or 4/5-star hotels near your hospital with kitchen facilities.

six_facilitation_services.title: Language Interpreter Support
six_facilitation_services.description: Dedicated language translators fluent in Arabic, Bengali, Dari/Pashto, French, Russian, and Swahili throughout your medical stay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the clean medical trust look: professional medical teal (#0D9488), deep clinical navy/slate (#0F172A), crisp white cards, and warm amber trust accents.
Prominently display the phone number +91 9920222362 in header, hero, floating WhatsApp button, contact page, and footer.
Implement the 10 treatments in a catalog page with instant specialty filtering and interactive search.
Create dynamic Treatment Detail pages (/treatments/:slug) showing cost comparisons (India vs US/UK), stay duration, hospital partner highlights, and inquiry form.
Build the 6 facilitation services section with step-by-step patient journey (Diagnosis -> Visa -> Travel -> Treatment -> Recovery -> Post-Care).
Include a 'Countries Served' ribbon / interactive selector highlighting patients from Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, UAE, Nigeria, Afghanistan, Iraq, Maldives, Oman, Kenya, Yemen.
Provide a working XML exporter at /export-data that generates valid WordPress WXR XML with full metadata and treatment posts.
Connect the inquiry forms to backend API `/api/inquiries` and ensure client-side state works seamlessly even if backend is mocked or static.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, links, and cards for automated testing.
